description: Implementation of auxiliary PID control logic for engine management, including thread handling, PWM control, and configuration checks.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific auxiliary PID channel is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: pidReset
methods.description: Resets the auxiliary PID controller state.

methods.name: auxPidThread
methods.description: Main thread function for auxiliary PID control loop, managing PWM output based on engine parameters.

methods.name: turnAuxPidOn
methods.description: Activates PWM for a specific auxiliary PID channel if enabled.

methods.name: startAuxPins
methods.description: Starts all auxiliary PID PWM channels.

methods.name: stopAuxPins
methods.description: Stops all auxiliary PID PWM channels.

methods.name: initAuxPid
methods.description: Initializes auxiliary PID control, creates control thread, and starts PWM channels.
